note: Literature on SGSM3-related disorder consistently reports global developmental delay and intellectual disability in affected individuals across described cohorts.

evidence.text: Affected individuals with homozygous SGSM3 variants displayed developmental delay and mild-to-moderate intellectual disability segregating with the phenotype.

source.title: Intellectual disability syndrome associated with a homozygous founder variant in SGSM3 in Ashkenazi Jews
source.quote: developmental delay and mild to moderate intellectual … intellectual disability. They all share a common homozygous frameshift variant in SGSM3, which segregated with the phenotype

evidence.text: Two siblings with a novel homozygous stop-gain variant in SGSM3 presented with intellectual disability findings and short stature.

source.title: A Strong Candidate Gene for Nonsyndromic Intellectual Disability Phenotype: SGSM3
source.quote: In this study, a novel homozygous stop-gain (NM_015705.6: c.1576C>T: p.(Arg526Ter)) variation was detected in the SGSM3 gene in two siblings with short stature and ID findings.
